'''Jax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] street punk who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] investigator [[Di'hal'uma]] discovered elements of a plot by the [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] [[Mebara Jos]] to attack the [[Cularin Classic]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop race]], Jos used Jax as an intermediary to hire some [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] thugs and the [[Blood Raptors]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] to capture the Twi'lek. Jax told the Corellians and the Blood Raptors that he was on his way to catch a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] bound for the resort [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]], and that he planned to take a few weeks vacation there.
